links.outcome: Adherence of LLM-generated neonatal resuscitation scenarios to NRP guideline algorithm and hallucination
links.effect: DeepSeek violated the NRP algorithm; ChatGPT scenarios were comparable to NRP overall but lacked consistent dynamic vital signs; no significant difference in hallucination between the two LLMs.
links.quote: DeepSeek manifested violations in NRP® algorithm.

unlisted_practices: Blinded expert instructor evaluation of LLM-generated simulation training scenarios against human-authored NRP scenarios before educational use

screen.reason: Multicenter reader study evaluating the feasibility, fidelity, and hallucinations of LLM-generated neonatal resuscitation simulation scenarios evaluated by instructors, without testing a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
